frozen_problem.title: The Hadwiger-Nelson Problem
frozen_problem.statement: What is the minimum number of colors needed to color the points of the plane such that no two points at distance 1 have the same color?
frozen_problem.selection_basis: PROVISIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_RANKED: the ranked queue and tracked dataset manifest were absent; repository preflight validated this unexpired pinned launch card, and no local pinned dataset snapshot was available for deterministic synchronization restoration.

selection_basis: PROVISIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_RANKED: selected only from the unexpired first-run card after preflight; this selection is not a research ranking.

theory.target: For the pinned 517-vertex graph and symmetry-broken CNF, determine exact clause-level equivalence to a four-coloring encoding and justify only the three explicit color locks.
definitions: For vertex v and color c in {1,2,3,4}, x(v,c)=4(v-1)+c denotes that v receives c.
Exact-one coloring uses one at-least-one clause and six pairwise at-most-one clauses per unlocked vertex; a locked vertex uses its positive unit clause instead of the at-least-one clause.
Proper coloring adds one same-color exclusion clause for every graph edge and every color.
Equisatisfiable up to color symmetry means a global permutation of color names maps models between the ordinary and locked encodings.
assumptions: The fetched files match their recorded SHA-256 digests.
Color names have no semantics beyond equality and inequality.
No unit-distance embedding or CNF unsatisfiability claim is assumed.
approaches_considered: Generate the canonical clause set from the graph and demand exact set equality with the pinned CNF; executed in this cycle.
Check the published SAT proof, minimize a verified unsatisfiable core, and translate core clauses into a human-auditable forcing chain; deferred until proof and checker artifacts are pinned.
falsification_targets: A malformed graph row, loop, duplicate, out-of-range endpoint, or count mismatch.
Any missing, unexpected, duplicate, tautological, or out-of-range CNF clause.
Absence of any one of triangle edges {1,2}, {1,6}, or {2,6}.
Any additional semantics that is not invariant under a global color permutation.

claims.statement: The pinned edge file parses as a simple graph on 517 vertices with 2,579 distinct edges.
claims.falsification_condition: A strict parse finds an input-hash mismatch, malformed row, loop, duplicate edge, out-of-range endpoint, or count mismatch.

claims.statement: The 13,935 pinned CNF clauses are exactly the symmetry-fixed exact-one four-coloring encoding of the pinned graph, with zero missing or unexpected clauses.
claims.falsification_condition: Exact clause-set comparison finds any missing or unexpected clause, or strict parsing finds an invalid clause.

claims.statement: The unit locks assigning colors 1, 2, and 3 to vertices 1, 2, and 6 preserve satisfiability under global color permutation because those vertices induce a triangle.
claims.falsification_condition: Any triangle edge is absent or the formula contains non-permutation-invariant color semantics.

claims.statement: The two cited arXiv abstracts support historical finite non-four-colorability and SAT-reduction claims but do not fingerprint the exact 517-vertex files audited here.
claims.falsification_condition: A cited primary version explicitly identifies and fingerprints the exact 517-vertex edge and CNF byte streams.

progress.summary: The opaque pinned CNF is reduced to an exact, clause-accounted graph-coloring formulation, and its only three color locks are justified by a K3 color-permutation lemma.

checks.method: Begin with adversarial clause and triangle-edge mutations, then run a fresh Python strict parser and exact expected-clause generator against the two hash-pinned inputs.
checks.independence_basis: The verification implementation was written in dependency-free Python from the raw edge/CNF formats after a separate JavaScript clause-accounting derivation; it did not consume the theory conclusion or reuse its code.
checks.result: PASS for structural scope: 517 vertices, 2,579 edges, 2,068 variables, 13,935 expected clauses, zero missing and zero unexpected; all three lock vertices form a triangle and every adversarial mutation was detected.
blocking_objections: No SAT or DRAT unsatisfiability check was performed.

checks.result: The abstracts support the 1,581- and 553-vertex historical claims, while the exact 517-byte lineage remains a separate repository-provenance obligation.
